primary_question: Does each model recover DepMap-aligned endpoint-relevant perturbation structure, or does it generate homogenized target-level outputs?

fixed_evaluation_regime.shift_definition: matched-control generated shift when supported; otherwise target-conditioned generated shift aligned to the frozen HCC scorer contract

required_output_contract.values: predicted expression shift in truth-aligned log-shift space

frozen_truth_rules.endpoint_categories: Frozen from observed_shift_mean_abs and dependency_strength before model scoring.

interpretation_guardrails: Do not interpret high predicted_shift_mean_abs alone as endpoint-relevant recovery.
Require endpoint alignment and axis-aligned recovery to support endpoint-relevant structure.
Treat high mean off-diagonal target-target similarity as an output-homogenization warning, not a performance metric.
Treat the observed-shift oracle as an observed-data reference only, not a predictive model entrant.
Treat backbone recovery as a secondary architecture diagnostic, not the primary endpoint-recovery claim.

recommended_order.action: Run endpoint recovery audit to establish current reference table.
Train or rerun CPA full materialization per cell line, then export both cell lines, then audit CPA only.
Run scGen smoke or full target set, export under a stable model_id, then audit immediately.
Stage/run CellOT per target only after export code exists for CellOT outputs; audit immediately after both cell lines pass contract.
